title: Fight Club
author: Chuck Palahniuk
summary: An insomniac office worker, bored with his life, falls in with a charismatic soap maker named Tyler Durden. Together they start an underground fighting club that grows into something far larger.
readIf: you like short, abrasive satire with a narrator you can't quite trust.
skipIf: you dislike nihilistic, macho violence or have already absorbed the film's big ideas.

pairings.reason: Another vicious, darkly funny novel about male emptiness and consumer culture, with a narrator who slips from reality.
Short, stylised and violent, and it likewise asks what society does with young men who crave chaos.
An older, gentler account of a narrator alienated from the world he is expected to join.
